blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The shear line is forecast to bring rains over the eastern section of Northern Luzon, while three other weather systems may affect parts of the country on Wednesday, Nov. 25, the state weather bureau said. In its 5 a.m. weather advisory, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the shear line may bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and isolated thunderstorms over Cagayan and Isabela. “As for the weather today in Luzon, we expect scattered rain showers in Cagayan and Isabela, brought by the shear line,” Pagasa weather specialist Chenel Dominguez said.
